<perturbed_code_1>
#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <queue>
#include <set>
#include <map>
#include <complex>
#include <ext/pb_ds/assoc_container.hpp>
#include <bitset>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <random>
#include <functional>
using namespace std;
using namespace __gnu_pbds;
long long A[20];
long long dfs(int ind, long long n) {
	if(ind == 0)
		return n == 0 ? 0 : 1e8;
	if(n < 0) n = -n;
	auto m = n / A[ind];
	return min(function<long long(int, long long)>(dfs)(ind-1, n - m * A[ind]) + m * ind,
				function<long long(int, long long)>(dfs)(ind-1, n - (m+1) * A[ind]) + (m + 1) * ind);
}
int main() {
	ios::sync_with_stdio(0); cin.tie(0);
	long long n;
	cin >> n;
	for(int i = 1; i <= 16; ++i)
		A[i] = A[i-1] * 10 + 1;
	cout << dfs(16, n) << '\n';
    return 0;
}
